name: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad del Paraguay 2025–2028 (Decreto N° 3900/2025)
owner: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación del Paraguay
description: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2025–2028 (enacted by Decreto N° 3900/2025 of May 22, 2025; text published November 14, 2024). National cybersecurity strategy of the Republic of Paraguay prepared by MITIC and CERT-PY.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación del Paraguay (mitic.gov.py) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación del Paraguay (mitic.gov.py).
